description: This is a PHP class definition for the 'Timesheet' entity within the OrangeHRM system, representing a timesheet with properties like ID, state, start/end dates, and associated employee. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: Timesheet
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet record with properties for ID, state, start/end dates, and linked employee, utilizing Doctrine ORM for persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the timesheet.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the timesheet.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the timesheet.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of the timesheet.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Gets the start date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this timesheet.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this timesheet.
